parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/PlayerControllerTestHarness.swift`. Despite a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8333), `postInterruptionBegan` and `postInterruptionEnded` are intentionally distinct test-harness helpers that model two semantically different audio-session interruption lifecycle events — began vs. ended. Merging or abstracting them would couple unrelated test scenarios and obscure the intent of each helper. The restraint marker `is_test: true` on every record dominates the action signal.
